tips.label: 不規則過去式
tips.text: 過去時間（yesterday、last...、...ago）出現時，一般動詞要用過去式；不規則變化要特別記憶。

tips.label: because 與 so
tips.text: because 引導原因；so 連接結果。句中有 because 時，不要再加 so。

tips.label: Why 問句
tips.text: Why + be 動詞 + 主詞...?；Why + did + 主詞 + 原形動詞...?

notes.title: 常見不規則動詞過去式
notes.rule: 原形 → 過去式，如 buy → bought、choose → chose、sell → sold、take → took
notes.description: 不規則動詞的過去式沒有固定規則，看到過去時間時要使用正確的過去式。did 或 didn't 後面則必須用原形。
examples: Dad sold his old computer last week.
Did you choose the red bag yesterday?

notes.title: because 表示原因
notes.rule: Because + 原因子句, 結果子句.／結果子句 + because + 原因子句.
notes.description: because 是連接詞，用來說明原因。because 放在句首時，兩個子句之間用逗號隔開。
examples: Because Harry could not cook, he ate out last night.
Harry ate out last night because he could not cook.

notes.title: so 表示結果
notes.rule: 原因子句, so + 結果子句.
notes.description: so 表示「所以」，連接原因與結果；前面通常加逗號。不要在同一句同時使用 because 和 so。
examples: It rained a lot, so I did not go out.
Ann broke her arm, so she went to the doctor.

notes.title: 詢問原因的 Why 問句
notes.rule: Why + was/were + 主詞...?／Why + did + 主詞 + 原形動詞...?
notes.description: be 動詞後直接接主詞；一般動詞問過去的事時用 did，後面的動詞要回到原形。回答常用 because 或 so 說明原因。
examples: Why was Ben late? — Because he missed the bus.
Why did you cry? — Because I was scared.

quiz.hint: last week 表過去，sell 的過去式是 sold。

quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去，break 的過去式是 broke。

quiz.hint: all night 指昨晚的動作，cry 的過去式是 cried。

quiz.hint: went 是過去式，前面的 become 也要用過去式 became。

quiz.question: We ___ action to help the poor family.
quiz.hint: 句子描述過去的行動，take 的過去式是 took。

quiz.question: The ball ___ the window yesterday.

quiz.hint: last Sunday 表過去，pick 的過去式是 picked。

quiz.hint: did not 已表示過去，後面用原形 help。

quiz.hint: scared 是形容詞，要用 be 動詞；last night 且主詞 you，用 were。

quiz.question: I was curious about the computer ___ it was new.
quiz.hint: 後半句說明原因，用 because。

quiz.question: The weather was terrible, ___ we did not go out.
quiz.hint: 天氣糟糕是原因，沒出門是結果，用 so。

quiz.hint: because 子句是過去式 was，主句也用過去式 cried。

quiz.hint: 沒有鞋子是原因，難過是結果，用 so。

quiz.hint: 主句 bought 是過去式，sell 要用過去式 sold。

quiz.hint: 天很黑是害怕的原因，用 because。

quiz.question: The children were tired, so they ___ home.
quiz.hint: 前句 were 是過去式，go 的過去式是 went。

quiz.question: Because the ending was sad, nobody ___.
quiz.hint: was 是過去式，smile 要用過去式 smiled。

quiz.question: Why ___ you choose those shoes?
quiz.hint: choose 是一般動詞，問過去原因用 Why did。

quiz.question: Why did Mom ___ chocolate?
quiz.hint: did 後面一定接原形 buy。

quiz.question: Why ___ the children crying?
quiz.hint: crying 是進行式，children 是複數，過去進行式用 were。

quiz.question: Why was the poor boy sad? — ___ he had no shoes.
quiz.hint: 回答原因用 Because。

quiz.question: Why did nobody answer? — They ___ not know the answer.
quiz.hint: 描述過去的否定一般動詞用 did not + 原形。

quiz.question: Why did Ann go to the doctor? — Her arm ___.
quiz.hint: 事情發生在過去，break 的過去式是 broke。

quiz.question: Why did you take action? — I ___ to help.
quiz.hint: 問句用 did，回答描述過去的想法，用 wanted。

quiz.question: Why was the baby crying? — She ___ hungry.
quiz.hint: 主詞 she 單數，過去狀態用 was。

quiz.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: A. Because it rained, we stayed home.
B. Because it rained, so we stayed home.
C. Because it rained, we stay home.
D. Because it raining, we stayed home.
quiz.hint: because 已連接原因與結果，同一句不可再加 so；過去式用 rained、stayed。

quiz.question: Choose the correct so sentence.
options: A. It was late because we went home.
B. It was late, so we went home.
C. It was late, because so we went home.
D. It late, so we went home.
quiz.hint: 原因在前、結果在後，用逗號加 so；be 動詞不能省略。

quiz.question: Choose the correct Why + be verb question.
options: A. Why did she was scared?
quiz.hint: scared 是形容詞，問句用 Why was + 主詞 + 形容詞。

quiz.question: Choose the correct Why + did question.
options: A. Why did he sold the computer?
B. Why he sold the computer?
C. Why was he sell the computer?
D. Why did he sell the computer?
quiz.hint: 一般動詞過去式問句用 Why did + 主詞 + 原形動詞。

quiz.question: Yesterday, I ___ a pair of shoes.
quiz.hint: Yesterday 表過去，buy 的過去式是 bought。

quiz.question: They ___ each other after class yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去，help 用過去式 helped。

quiz.question: Nobody ___ the answer last night.
quiz.hint: last night 表過去，know 的過去式是 knew。

quiz.question: At the age of six, he ___ school.
quiz.hint: 句子說過去的事，start 用過去式 started。

quiz.question: The marriage ___ important in her life.
quiz.hint: marriage 是單數名詞；描述過去，用 was。

quiz.question: People under eighteen ___ not drink.
quiz.hint: 表示能力或允許時用 can；can 後面接原形 drink。

quiz.question: He went to that school ___ a choice.
quiz.hint: without a choice 表「沒有選擇」。

quiz.question: The children played with ___.
quiz.hint: 彼此互相做某事用 each other。

quiz.question: The movie was interesting, but its ending ___ sad.
quiz.hint: ending 是單數，描述過去用 was。

quiz.question: She does not live there ___.
quiz.hint: not...anymore 表「不再」。
